visual.title: Sample means bunch up as the sample grows
visual.caption: Raise n: the histogram of means narrows like 1/sqrt(n) and turns normal, even though the population stays skewed.

predict.question: As the sample size grows, the spread of the sample mean does what?
options: Shrinks like 1 divided by the square root of n
predict.explain: Averaging more observations cancels more of their noise, and the standard error is the population spread divided by the square root of n.
